T7_models_cpa.title: Table 7. Annual percent change (APC) of administrative-recognition indicators of autism by estimand and sensitivity, Chile 2019–2025 — F84 without Rett variant

S_hospital_rates_2024.title: Table S3. Episodes with documented F84 per 100,000 GRD episodes by hospital, 2024, with hospital effects 2019–2024 — F84 without Rett variant

Fixed-effect RR: quasi-Poisson 2019–2024 with hospital indicators, common trend and log(episodes) offset, expressed against the geometric mean of hospitals (without and with adjustment for hospital-year coding depth). S6_stable_panel.title: Table S6. REM totals over all establishments and over the stable panel, with percentages of volume and establishments retained — F84 without Rett variant

S7_a05_standardised_rates.title: Table S7. REM A05 entries per 100,000 INE population: crude and WHO age-standardised rates by series, year and sex, with reporting establishments — F84 without Rett variant

S8_a05_age_sex.title: Table S8. REM A05 entries by age group, sex and year (age × sex cells), strict autism and PDD family — F84 without Rett variant

S13_rem_seasonality.title: Table S13. REM monthly totals, establishments with a row in the month and index relative to the annual mean (A05 and A03) — F84 without Rett variant

ST8_grd_identifier_audit.title: Table ST8. Audit of the person identifier of the public GRD by year, 2019–2024: validity, within-year uniqueness, format and informative overlap between years — F84 family excluding Rett syndrome variant

ST9_grd_age_sex.title: Table ST9. GRD episodes with documented F84 by sex and five-year age group, 2019–2024: number and rate per 100,000 GRD episodes of the same sex-age cell (observed panel, all modalities) — F84 family excluding Rett syndrome variant

E15b_rem_p6_territory.note: Unit: people under control with strict autism (December stock, COL01). Denominator: INE resident population by region (Census 2017 base, 30 June). Coverage: public network reporting the code; the region is that of the reporting unit, not of residence. Definition era: P6241010 and P6241060, 2021–2025 (strict autism era). Reporting N: n in brackets = establishments with a December row for the code. Counts are administrative recognition and recorded activity, never prevalence or incidence. Sources are not person-linked: there is no individual cascade and no ratios between unlinked sources; A03, A05, A27 and A28 count records or interventions, not persons. Series A is a flow (sum of months) and Series P is a stock (December as the main measure, June as a sensitivity; semesters are never summed). Every definition era is shown separately and no line crosses a break. REM locates the provider (place of care), not residence; rates against INE population are ecological. Zero, empty cell and 'not reported' (absent row) are kept distinct and never imputed, and 'outside the era' means the code did not exist that year. 2020–2021: pandemic reporting disruption; Law 21.545 (March 2023) is policy context, not an intervention with an estimable effect. In territorial tables, cells with fewer than 5 events are shown as '<5'; 'not reported' means the region filed no row for that code that year. Source: REM Serie P (SerieP_2019.csv … SerieP_2025.csv, DEIS/MINSAL); ine_population_region_national_year_age_sex.csv (proyecciones INE, base Censo 2017, 30 de junio); outputs/tidy/rem_pathway_tidy.csv, rem_pathway_annual.csv, rem_establishment_year.csv.
